mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3% monthly signals stronger household income growth, boosting consumption and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Houston housing price index exceeding 5% signals weakening housing demand, which reduces household wealth and discretionary spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing output, which boosts corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3% monthly combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.3% monthly for 3 months AND UNRATE < 4% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).
